messages:
julia: quick sync re: AWS SaaS Marketplace onboarding for Acme. Their SI wants a single SKU mapping that works with metering and entitlement checks. Do we have a canonical recommended flow?

omar: short flow we use: 1) Create SaaS listing JSON + entitlement SKU; 2) Accept AWS metering events (Metering Service) -> forward to our ingestion pipeline; 3) Use entitlement token exchange to validate access on first request. Keep conversion manual for trial.

leah: ops checklist (AWS-specific): PublisherAcctID, Listing JSON, SaaS API endpoint, entitlement validation endpoint, metering endpoint stub, IAM role for marketplace tests. Also decide whether to use AMI-based offer (no) or SaaS API (yes).

sandeep: product note: trial plan = 30d, token cap 100k, manual conversion. For entitlements we should issue a short-lived entitlement token on first prologue call and map to our internal customer id.

julia: legal asked about billing visibility: partner needs clear language that AWS may show charges for marketplace fees but we won't auto-bill without manual opt-in. Also need telemetry disclosure: we only collect usage metadata.

marketplace-bot: templates: s3://redwood-marketplace/aws/templates/saas-listing.json and metering webhook sample at https://internal.re/hooks/aws/metering-stub. See docs: https://internal.re/marketplace/aws/saas-playbook

omar: paste minimal listing JSON we hand to partners (sanitized):
```json
{"product":"redwood-inference","listingType":"SaaS","plans":[{"id":"trial30","displayName":"30 Day Trial","entitlement":"trial-30d","usageLimit":{"tokens_per_month":100000}}],"support":"partners@redwood.ai","entitlementValidationUrl":"https://api.redwood.internal/marketplace/aws/validate"}
```

leah: note on metering: AWS sends metering events with customer identifier. We must validate signature, dedupe events (metering_id), and map to plan usage. Add replay protection (nonce/timestamp).

sandeep: SI (DeltaSys) requested a small Terraform snippet for creating the AWS IAM role they need to test subscription calls. Can someone paste a minimal snippet?

omar: here's a tiny example they can use:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_test" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-test"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{Effect = "Allow", Principal = {Service = "ecs.amazonaws.com"}, Action = "sts:AssumeRole"}]
  })
}
```

julia: action items: omar = post sanitized listing JSON to partner + create OfferID in portal; leah = implement metering webhook stub + replay/dedupe; sandeep = draft entitlement token flow doc for SI. legal will post required marketplace copy.

leah: I'll spin up the webhook stub at https://hooks.internal/re/aws/metering-stub and enable test events. Will add header validation X-Marketplace-Signature and log events to a test bucket s3://redwood-marketplace/aws/acme/tests.

sandeep: drafting entitlement flow: customer buys trial -> AWS issues entitlement record -> partner/webhook hits our entitlementValidationUrl -> we verify entitlement and return short-lived access token. Will post doc by EOD.

julia: final question: hardware partner Infracore asked if they can bundle a dedicated-accelerator SKU later. For marketplace launch we should avoid hardware SKUs; treat as separate enterprise private deployment.

omar: agree, keep marketplace simple SaaS only. Hardware bundles go through dedicated capacity sales motion.

julia: thanks team. I'll schedule the partner handoff for tomorrow 9:30am PT and attach the JSON + Terraform snippet. Will update thread with OfferID when available. :white_check_mark:
